description: Job Description Summary Supporting Sourcing activities for Category Team that includes supplier price updates, contract management, RFQ execution, payment-term updates, COOR compliance, supplier issue resolution, and coordination with cross-functional teams to ensure uninterrupted supply and operational efficiency. title: Civil Engineer Trainee
